findings.summary: The cheap route for an edit that changes nothing records D08 as amended when it is not.
findings.evidence: decisions.rs lines 30-33 define `Amended` as 'The older decision is revised in part (or in prose only)'. `DecisionView.amended_by` (decisions.rs 113) is derived from these links. Backtest condition (a) also requires an amend phrase in the log at the link's `line`. So the cheap route makes the log say 'amends D08' in an entry that does not amend it, and D08's view lists it as amended. The plan expects about 3-4% of commits to take this route, each time writing a false amendment into an append-only log. Fix: Do not suggest the `amended` route for edits that do not reverse a decision. Either have the failure reason ask for a real amendment only, or name a separate acknowledgement (a third status, or a separate table with no log phrase) as an open question or follow-up. If the route is kept, state in D156 and the toml header that 'amended' here can mean 'checked against D08, no change'.
findings.location: Decisions 9 and Risks 1 (the 'checked, unchanged' entry plus an `amended` link)

findings.summary: The producer sees the finding only after a manual retry, though the producer loop has a send-back seam and producer.rs is not banned outright.
findings.evidence: producer.rs 259-342 already gathers `problems` (unmet criteria, unchanged files, held replay) and sends them back within the same run, and `snapshot.change_list()` (263-267) already gives the changed paths. The out_of_scope entry for producer.rs is worded as 'Re-doing the dropped candidate of job 20261010-225741-yvk0', not as a ban on the file. As planned, a gated job fails and a person must run `athena retry` before the producer sees the decision ids. The reading's goal was 'the producer gets the failure at the producer step'. Criterion 5 names check_and_verify, so the plan meets the criterion as written. Fix: Keep the gate in check_and_verify, which criterion 5 requires. In the open question, state that the out-of-scope list rules out re-doing the earlier candidate, not editing producer.rs, and that the pure `unreconciled` function lets a same-run send-back be added as one more entry in `problems`.

findings.summary: The HISTORY.txt count of commits touching the D08 paths is overstated: 8 where the exact paths give 6.
findings.evidence: A Grep count of HISTORY.txt for `athena-git/src/snapshot.rs|run/candidate.rs` returns 6 matches (I ran it). The plan's 8 comes from the looser pattern `snapshot.rs|candidate.rs`, which can also match other files with those names. Fix: Quote 6 of 200 recent commits (about 3%) for the two exact paths, and label it a measurement of the exact paths.
findings.location: Decision 9 and Demonstration 7 ('8 matching lines of 200')

findings.evidence: The after_help text (main.rs 250-288) contains backticks, and the template will contain `{ceiling}`. If the template is filled with `format!`, any other brace added to the text later would break it. Fix: Fill the placeholder with `str::replace("{ceiling}", ..)`, which the test that no `{ceiling}` survives already covers.

summary: Round 2 answers the round-one major finding. I checked it against the code: `retry_findings` (reading.rs 1780-1806) returns None when a job has no verification. `JobRecords.outcome` (store.rs 33) holds the closing state and reason the plan wants to read. The gate's reason has no ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX, so `StopCause::of` (disk.rs 469-491) classes it as Work and `settle_resume_marks` (mod.rs 680-694) spends the mark, so the retry reaches `retry_findings` (mod.rs 923-927). The gate's placement is real: `check_and_verify` (mod.rs 1533) runs `push_ci_branch` at 1552 and `early_pr` at 1556, and `closing.candidate.changes` already gives the changed paths (1582-1586). The other names the plan relies on also exist: `self.nested`, `Git::show_file` (athena-git lib.rs 452), `MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING: u32 = 8` (config.rs 269), the literal `at most 8` (main.rs 275), the `help_of` closure (main.rs 1824), the run/tests.rs fixtures at the cited lines, all inside `produce_and_verify_order_tests` (73-5386), and the real-list test in tests/backtest.rs 131. athena-data already depends on serde and toml. Each demonstration names a seam the code provides, would fail without the behavior, and checks a real result rather than a double. The dependents list covers the readers I found for decision-links.toml, ConfirmedLinks, retry_findings, the drain help and check_and_verify. What remains is minor: the reconcile route for edits that change nothing marks D08 as "amended" when it is not; the producer still learns of the failure only on a manual retry, although the producer loop has a natural send-back seam; and the HISTORY count is overstated. None of these blocks the plan.
